title: BlueRock Consulting — Brand & Website Modernization
goal: Clarify positioning and proof; convert interest into qualified conversations.
summary: Messaging framework (value props, services, proof points), credibility-scannable IA, lightweight design system, performance & accessibility targets, lead-flow map.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Role: UX & Content Design
Domain: B2B Services, Marketing
Scope: Messaging, IA, design system, research, copy, lead flow
Team: [X designers/content, Y devs]
Timeframe: [Q#/Year – Q#/Year]

sections.title: Goal & Constraints
sections.body: Clarify positioning and surface credible proof while keeping the site lean; guide visitors to a structured contact pathway that qualifies leads.

sections.title: What I Led
sections.body:
• Org & Ops — Engagement kickoff, staffing, budget, plan; parallel brand + web tracks.
• Research & Insights — Stakeholder interviews; heuristics evaluation; competitor and gap analysis.
• Product & IA — Messaging framework; credibility-first IA (Who / What / Proof / Start).
• Design & Systems — Component library; performance/a11y-targeted templates; content writing and editing.
• Delivery & Quality — Lead-flow (scheduler + structured intake); QA and launch checklist.
• Stakeholders & Decisions — Executive reviews; copy approvals; performance/a11y sign-offs.

sections.title: Research & Discovery
sections.body: We captured leadership’s value propositions, audited the current site, and mapped competitor signals to ensure proof density where buyers look first.

sections.title: Mental Models → Messaging & IA
sections.body: We mapped how buyers scan: What you do → Proof → How to start, then structured IA so those answers are always within one scroll.

sections.title: Information Architecture
sections.body: Services and outcomes are explicit; case evidence and bios are anchored to decision points; navigation trims friction to the contact flow.

sections.title: Prototypes (Lo-Fi → Hi-Fi)
sections.body: Hi-fi pages for Home, Services, Case Studies, and Contact, plus a lead-flow with scheduler and structured intake to reduce ping-pong.

sections.title: Operating Mechanisms
sections.body: Copy rules, component governance, and a compact scorecard for qualified-lead capture and page performance keep the site improving without bloat.

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.body:
Clearer narrative, denser proof, higher-quality lead capture, improved performance and accessibility.
